snapshot.capture_method: SQLite Connection.backup from the live database (mode=ro, including committed WAL) into a preparation copy; only approved Groups added; SQLite backup again into final standalone read-only snapshot.
snapshot.scope_preparation: Drew approved baseline-only Groups on 2026-09-18 because the live library had none. Live database unchanged; no Sync, re-embedding, or transcript/Video/Segment changes.

embedding.stored_passages: Existing production CUDA vectors reused. Database stores model name/dimension, not historical per-passage revision; listed revision is the cached query-model revision pinned for this run.

boundary: Query embedding and reranking against stored CUDA passage vectors; not passage-embedding equivalence or a chat-model evaluation.
